packageRules.description: Non-major external dependency updates ride one grouped draft branch per cycle. No auto-merge: GitHub refuses to attach it to a draft PR, and every PR must open as a draft because the code-foundry gates only run on the ready-for-review transition — a human marks each batch ready and merges it once the gates pass.
Major external bumps share one draft PR per cycle instead of one per package — a grouped major PR reads as one upgrade decision.
Code Foundry runtime pins are sync-managed (runtime_ref in code-foundry.yml) and must not be independently upgraded; a bump branched before a sync can resurrect legacy caller files when merged.
